meta.titulo: Valejas Atlético Clube | Our town's club since 1966
meta.descricao: Sports club in Valejas, Oeiras. Federated futsal and athletics, strong youth development, plus judo, karate, dance, theatre and the Senior Academy. The club's home since 1966.
meta.descricaoPartilha: Futsal, athletics, karate, cycling, judo, dance and theatre. Plus the Senior Academy. The club's home since 1966.

hero.texto: We are all Valejas. Since 1966, our town's club — from futsal to athletics, from the youngest to the veterans.

mote.contexto: It isn't just a nice phrase: it's how the club has worked for 60 years. Those who play, those who coach, those who open the clubhouse and those who pay their membership — everything Valejas is comes from that.

conhecer.titulo: A club can't be explained <destaque>in one sentence</destaque>
conhecer.texto: {anos} years is room for a lot: {origens} activities at the start, {modalidades} sports today, and people who join as children and stay for life. Choose where to begin.

historia.texto: {anos} years, starting with athletics, cycling and malha — long before futsal. What we know, and what is still to be discovered.

emblema.texto: What each part means, and why the club plays in yellow and blue.

modalidades.texto: From the sports hall to the track and the road, plus dance and theatre. Some compete in federated leagues, others exist purely to teach.

jogos.texto: {jornadas} rounds in the AF Lisboa district league, {emCasa} of them at home. Fixtures, results and standings.

instalacoes.texto: The clubhouse, where the Board works and the Academy meets. And the sports hall, where the games are played.

orgaos.texto: The Board, the Audit Committee and the General Assembly Board. All members, most of them for decades.

academia.texto: {n} activities, from choir to chi kung. The club doesn't end when you stop competing.

patrocinadores.texto: The local businesses and people who keep the club on its feet.
